name: diptrace-mcp
description: Read, review and perform guarded edits on DipTrace PCB and schematic projects through MCP.
long_description: A local Windows MCP server for DipTrace XML analysis and guarded engineering workflows. The bundle contains the standalone MCP server. Live exchange with an open DipTrace document additionally requires the DipTrace bridge plug-in from the matching GitHub release or source tree.

workspace.title: DipTrace workspace
workspace.description: Directory containing projects that the MCP server may read or modify.

state_directory.title: DipTrace MCP state directory
state_directory.description: Directory for sessions, backups, logs and local records.
